data.name: Maslamah
data.gender_notes: Maslamah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Maslamah is a name derived from the Arabic word 'maslaha', which means refuge or protection. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes seeking safety and shelter in Allah. The name Maslamah carries the meaning “Refuge in Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maslamah usually hope their child will grow to embody refuge in allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The one who seeks refuge in Allah's mercy and guidance.
data.etymology: Maslamah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Refuge in Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maslamah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: مسلَمة
in_arabic.meaning: المسلِمَةُ الَّتِي تُصَلِّى وَتُؤمِن في الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: المسلِمَةُ الَّتِي تُصَلِّى وَتُؤمِن في الله وَتُعظُمُ الأَعْمَالَ وَتَزكِيُ الأَخلاقَ، وَتَرغُبُ في السَّلامِ وَتَستَقبلُ الغُروبَ بِالرَجاءِ، وَتَقومُ بِالنَواظِرِ عَنِ العِبادَةِ، وَتُرتَجى في الدُنيا وَتُتَبَرَكُ في الآخِرَةِ، وَتُطيعُ الَّذِي أَمَرَ، وَتَرغَبُ في الذُرُورِ وَتَشُقُّ الطُرُقَ، وَتَنشُدُ الرِزقَ وَتَتَمَنَّى الخُلُقَ، وَتُؤمِنُ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي يُجَرِّبُ وَيُصَلِّي وَيَرزُقُ، وَتَسلَمُ مِنَ اللَّهِ الَّذِي يَمُنُّ وَيَبَرُّ، وَتَستَعينُ عَلى النَواظِرِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الَّذِي يَنصُرُ وَيُؤمِنُ، وَتَرجُعُ إلى اللَّهِ الَّذِي يَرجِعُ وَيُؤمِنُ
